import csv,json
from decimal import Decimal
source = "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/materials/expenses.csv"
json_path = "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/project/B2/artifacts/summary.json"
md_path = "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/project/B2/artifacts/summary_zh.md"
expected = {}
with open(source, encoding="utf-8", newline="") as source_file:
    for row in csv.DictReader(source_file):
        fen = Decimal(row["amount_yuan"]) * Decimal(100)
        assert fen == fen.to_integral_value()
        item = expected.setdefault(row["category"], {"row_count": 0, "total_fen": 0, "ids": []})
        item["row_count"] += 1
        item["total_fen"] += int(fen)
        item["ids"].append(row["id"])
expected = {key: expected[key] for key in sorted(expected)}
with open(json_path, encoding="utf-8") as result_file:
    actual = json.load(result_file)
assert list(actual) == sorted(actual)
assert actual == expected
with open(md_path, encoding="utf-8") as markdown_file:
    markdown = markdown_file.read()
for key, item in expected.items():
    row = "| {} | {} | {} | {} |".format(key, item["row_count"], item["total_fen"], ", ".join(item["ids"]))
    assert row in markdown
print("business_validation=passed; categories={}; rows={}".format(len(expected), sum(item["row_count"] for item in expected.values())))
